sloka: भ्रातृभिः च सुरान् युद्धे समग्रान् न अभिचिंतये ।तत् सहायो भव त्वम् मे समर्थो हि असि राक्षस ॥३-३६-१५॥
transliteration: bhrātṛbhiḥ ca surān yuddhe samagrān na abhiciṁtaye ।tat sahāyo bhava tvam me samartho hi asi rākṣasa ॥3-36-15॥

translations.english: You are mighty. I do not care to fight even the gods when you and my brothers are by my side. Therefore, O demon, be my accomplice. (I know) you are capable of that.
